title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
房间内，陆白正在细细体悟自己新获得的力量。拓印自举父的天赋能力升级之后，不仅让他本就变态的体质更为变态，脸接炮弹都没问题。而且还让他多出了一份新的能力——操控重力。而比翼鸟的天赋能力升级之后也是如此。让陆白精神力量暴增，能够制造出更加真实幻象的同时，也多出了一项与之相关的衍生能力，入梦。“这是要我将神棍这项伟大的事业进行到底啊。”陆白嘴角带笑。如此大的收获，让他决定让美利坚的人民多感受一下来自异世界的温暖。就从完善卢克.邓肯身上的故事开始好了。作出决定的陆白眼中闪过一道红光，悄然发动了自己的新能力——入梦。......按照现代心理学家的理论，梦不是偶然形成的联想，而是压抑的欲望。人们在日常生活中经历的种种，经过潜意识的扭曲、压缩之后，化为了一个个瑰丽不可思议的梦境。而且最重要的一点，普通人在梦境中往往是很难保持清醒的，甚至随着年龄的增长，你甚至都很难想起自己在梦中经历了什么。。。。。。但就在今天，在陆白的入梦能力面前，这些现代心理学家总结出来的梦境规律统统被打破了。还在哈德逊河河水里面泡着的卢克.邓肯，人还是迷迷糊糊的，就发现自己的意识好像被拉进了一个无比真实的梦境里面。在这里他不再是一个碌碌无为，连妻子的心都无法挽留的中年社畜，而是一名隶属于伟大的阿兹特克帝国的年轻美洲虎战士。他身着绿色皮甲，脸上绘有红绿条纹，手中握着绘有可怖花纹的蒙皮木盾和黑曜石木棍，和其他战士同伴一起，在丛林中狩猎敌人。那一战他勇猛无比，一人就杀死了敌对部落足足九名战士。人们为他的勇猛而欢呼，为他的战绩而庆贺，称呼他为伟大雄鹰的后裔。为此他还获得了参加雨神特拉洛克祭典的资格。那是在一座高大神圣的月亮金字塔上。人们围绕着挂有雨神特拉洛克面具的青铜柱，举行盛大又庄严的献祭仪式。在战斗中表现优异的卢克获得了亲手向神明献上祭品的殊荣。他手持黑曜石匕首，来到一名他亲手俘虏的、眼神凶狠的战俘面前，用那柄锋利的黑曜石匕首剖出了对方的心脏。“黑曜石匕首，是这个......”梦做到这里，卢克.邓肯突然惊醒，浑身湿漉漉地爬到了岸边。他举起自己右手，神色颇为复杂地看着右手手腕上戴着的、母亲临终时留给他的手链。在明亮的月光映照下，黑曜石材质的手链闪动着一阵暗沉的微光。跟卢克.邓肯在梦境中见到的那柄黑曜石刀一模一样。“原来是这样吗，母亲，是你在保佑着我......”这样一切就都说得通了。感受着这份间隔十几年时间、沉甸甸的母爱，卢克.邓肯脸上露出释然之色，心中的迷茫无助一扫而空。

他觉得自己找到了新的人生目标和方向！！！在没有被官方抓住之前，他要回到母亲出生的那个印第安部落看看。“我记得......那个部落好像是在宾夕法尼亚州......”利用初中学过的地理知识，大概辨别了一下方向，卢克.邓借着夜色，悄无声息跳上了一辆路边快速驶过的货车。......另一边，位于下曼哈顿警察广场1号，门口刻着‘至死忠诚’格言的纽约警察局总部大楼里。人到中年，身材已经略微发福，发际线更是看着让人忧伤的雷.凯利，正在办公室里焦躁地走来走去，等待来自哈德逊河上搜查队的消息。他发誓就算是妻子露西怀孕临产的时候，他都没有这么紧张过。毕竟孩子没了可以再生，这一次不能抓住卢克.邓肯的话，他下半辈子的政治前途基本上是完蛋了。“上帝保佑，一定要让乔治找到并且抓住卢克.邓肯那个怪胎......”雷.凯利不知道在心里默默祈祷了多久。终于，桌面上响起的电话给他带来了一个不算坏的消息。目标人物没能发现那枚特制狙击子弹遗留在他身上的信息素。警局经过特别培训的警犬已经顺着味道，找到了卢克.邓肯的大致踪迹。他在距离纽约城区一百多公里的公路旁上岸，最终，似乎是乘坐交通工具，向着宾夕法尼州的方向去了。“非常好......乔治，干得漂亮！！”能这么快得到卢克.邓肯的线索，让雷.凯利心中悬着的大石头落地。他一边兴奋地挥舞着手臂，一边在电话里大声称赞自己手下这位得力干将，同时也有一点疑惑。因为根据警方的调查，卢克.邓肯的人际关系网非常简单。除了公司的几个同事外，关系最好的，可能就是附近肯德基店的老板，因为卢克.邓肯经常在他那买汉堡。而这些人都在纽约。“我猜测可能跟卢克母亲出生的印第安部落有关，局长......”乔治.詹特利不愧是用有着‘纽约神探’称号的警探。办事一如既往的专业靠谱！！在雷.凯利问出这个问题后，立马给予了解答，沉声道：“作为最早的联邦自治州之一，宾夕法尼亚州保留有多个印第安人领地。”“其中位于女妖镇附近的印第安保留地，是卢克.邓肯母亲索菲亚出生的部落。”“以卢克.邓肯目前复完仇之后的迷茫状态，有很大可能前往那里。”“那还等什么？”听完乔治.詹特利的分析，雷.凯利更兴奋了，白胖的脸庞上泛着红光，仿佛看到了一个巨大的功劳在向自己招手。拿到这个功劳之后，说不定他能竞选下一届的纽约州州议员。不，就算是竞选纽约市市长也有可能！！！

In the room, Lu Bai was carefully comprehending his newly acquired power.After the upgrade of Rubbing Bootstrap's natural ability, it not only made his already perverted physique even more perverted, but also allowed him to receive cannonballs in the face without any problem.And it also gave him a new ability-controlling gravity.The same is true after the Biyi Bird's natural ability is upgraded.Lu Bai's mental power increased dramatically, and while he was able to create more realistic illusions, he also gained a related derivative ability: falling into dreams."This requires me to carry out this great cause of the magic stick to the end." Lu Bai smiled at the corner of his mouth.Such a huge harvest made him decide to let the people of America feel more of the warmth from another world.Let’s start by perfecting the story of Luke Duncan.After Lu Bai made the decision, a red light flashed in his eyes, and he quietly activated his new ability - falling into a dream....According to the theory of modern psychologists, dreams are not accidental associations, but repressed desires.All the things people experience in their daily lives are transformed into magnificent and incredible dreams after being distorted and compressed by the subconscious.And the most important point is that it is often difficult for ordinary people to stay awake in dreams. Even as you grow older, it is difficult for you to even remember what you experienced in your dreams......But today, in the face of Lu Bai's ability to enter dreams, all the dream laws summarized by these modern psychologists were broken.Luke Duncan, who was still in a daze while soaking in the water of the Hudson River, found that his consciousness seemed to be pulled into an extremely real dream.Here he is no longer a middle-aged social beast who does nothing and cannot even win the heart of his wife, but a young jaguar warrior who belongs to the great Aztec Empire.He wears green leather armor with red and green stripes painted on his face. He holds a leather wooden shield with horrific patterns and an obsidian stick in his hand. Together with other warrior companions, he hunts enemies in the jungle.He was so brave in that battle that he killed nine warriors from the enemy tribe by himself.People cheered for his bravery, celebrated for his achievements, and called him a descendant of the great eagle.For this reason, he also gained the qualification to participate in the ceremony of Tlaloc, the rain god.It was on a tall sacred pyramid of the moon.People held a grand and solemn sacrificial ceremony around the bronze pillar with the mask of Tlaloc, the rain god.Luke performed well in the battle and was given the honor of personally offering sacrifices to the gods.Holding an obsidian dagger in his hand, he came to a prisoner of war with fierce eyes whom he had captured personally, and used the sharp obsidian dagger to cut out the prisoner's heart."Obsidian dagger, it's this..." When the dream reached this point, Luke Duncan suddenly woke up and crawled to the shore wet.He raised his right hand and looked at the bracelet on his right wrist that his mother left to him when she died with a complicated expression.Under the bright moonlight, the obsidian bracelet flashed with a dark shimmer.It was exactly the same as the obsidian knife Luke Duncan saw in his dream."So that's it, mother, it's you who are protecting me..." Then everything makes sense.Feeling this heavy mother's love after more than ten years, Luke Duncan showed a look of relief on his face, and the confusion and helplessness in his heart was swept away.

He felt that he had found a new goal and direction in life!!!Before he was caught by the authorities, he wanted to go back to the Indian tribe where his mother was born."I remember... that tribe seems to be in Pennsylvania..." Using the geography knowledge he learned in junior high school, he roughly identified the direction. Luke Deng took advantage of the darkness and quietly jumped onto a truck that was passing quickly by the roadside....On the other side, in the New York Police Department headquarters building at 1 Police Plaza in Lower Manhattan, with the motto "Faithful Until Death" engraved on the door.Ray Kelly, who is middle-aged, has slightly gained weight, and has a sad-looking hairline, is walking around anxiously in the office, waiting for news from the search team on the Hudson River.He swore that he had never been so nervous even when his wife Lucy was pregnant and giving birth.After all, the child can be reborn. If Luke Duncan cannot be caught this time, his political future for the rest of his life will basically be doomed."God bless, let George find and capture that freak Luke Duncan..." Ray Kelly didn't know how long he prayed silently in his heart.Finally, the phone ringing on the table brought him not bad news.The target failed to detect the pheromones left on his body by the specially crafted sniper bullet.The specially trained police dogs of the police department have followed the smell and found the general traces of Luke Duncan.He landed next to a highway more than 100 kilometers away from New York City. Finally, he seemed to take transportation and headed towards Pennsylvania."Very good... George, well done!!" Being able to get Luke Duncan's clues so quickly made Ray Kelly's heart drop.He waved his arms excitedly and loudly praised his right-hand man on the phone, but he was also a little confused.Because according to the police investigation, Luke Duncan's interpersonal network is very simple.Except for a few colleagues in the company, the one with the best relationship may be the owner of the nearby KFC store, because Luke Duncan often buys burgers from him.And these people are in New York."I guess it may have something to do with the Indian tribe where Luke's mother was born, Director..." George Gentry is indeed a police detective with the title of 'New York Detective'.The work is always professional and reliable!!After Ray Kelly asked this question, he immediately gave the answer and said in a deep voice: "As one of the earliest federal autonomous states, Pennsylvania reserves multiple Indian territories." "The Indian reservation located near Banshee Town is the tribe where Luke Duncan's mother Sophia was born."With Luke Duncan's current confused state after his revenge, he is very likely to go there.""Then what are you waiting for?"After listening to George Gentry's analysis, Ray Kelly became even more excited, his face glowing red, as if he saw a huge achievement waving to him.After getting this credit, maybe he can run for the next New York State Assembly.No, even running for mayor of New York City is possible!!!
